info.name: Compcri AI Calendar API — v1
info.description: Generated from the Compcri OpenAPI 3.1 contract. Voice messages use OpenAI transcription, the configured text assistant, and MP3 speech generation. External calendars, coupons, and direct card handling are outside v1.

exec: const data = pm.response.json().data; if (data?.accessToken) pm.environment.set('accessToken', data.accessToken); if (data?.refreshToken) pm.environment.set('refreshToken', data.refreshToken);
